intro: This 11 October 2026 SSC CGL Tier 1 review brings together unofficial candidate reports. The shift cards show section difficulty and recalled topics from the remaining sources. Some reviews have limited evidence and need further corroboration. Exam-wide survey averages are excluded from shift-specific good-attempt estimates; an unavailable total means no reliable recommendation is being made. SSC publishes the official answer key and applies its own score normalisation.

faqs.q: What overall difficulty was reported for Shift 1 on 11 October 2026?
faqs.a: Candidates described Shift 1 as moderate in overall difficulty, with mixed views on the reasoning and quantitative sections ranging from easy‑moderate to moderate‑difficult.

faqs.q: Did candidates notice any time pressure during the exam on 11 October 2026?
faqs.a: Yes, candidates in Shift 1 noted time pressure because each section allowed only 15 minutes for 25 questions, and similar concerns were mentioned for quantitative problems in Shift 3.

faqs.q: Are the reported figures for the 11 October 2026 exam official?
faqs.a: No, the figures are unofficial and are based on candidate reports; the SSC normalises scores across shifts for official evaluation.

faqs.q: Why are some good-attempt figures unavailable for 11 October 2026?
faqs.a: A pooled survey average, accuracy percentage or conflicting total does not establish how many questions were safe to attempt in a particular shift. Those figures are withheld rather than replaced with guesses.
